notes: Root administration and data-integration URLs must never default to a child surface the user cannot actually use. They resolve to the first child route permitted by the effective Core permission set, and protected children remain suppressed while the redirect is pending. Administration landing resolution follows the full current ADMIN_NAV_REQUIREMENTS matrix, including Cost Catalog access through any of its category/product CRUD capabilities and the email/template/mail-operation/operation-capability sections. The general new-import landing is available only with imports.create plus fairs.read because its fair selection is mandatory; imports.create alone still authorizes fair-scoped import creation but does not create a valid Data Integration root landing. No role-name inference or backend authorization change is introduced.
_comment: Contract-only alignment with current firstAccessibleAdminPath and firstAccessibleDataIntegrationPath behavior.
